answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 158058 Country: India Title: I have been married since 3 years. Till now my wife dint get pregnant. She says offspring are given by Allah. Please can you give me some wazifah and prophetic medicine for the child. Question: I have been married since 3 years. Till now my wife dint get pregnant. She says offspring are given by Allah. Please can you give me some wazifah and prophetic medicine for the child. Answer ID: 158058 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 546/432/B=4/1439) Keep on reciting the below dua extensively, in-shaAllah, you shall have children: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْداً وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
